title: Gideon v. Wainwright, 372 U.S. 335
authors: Supreme Court of the United States
lineage: Inspected the identified passage; local file contains paraphrased research notes.

passages.note: The Court decided on 18 March 1963 that Gideon, charged with a Florida noncapital felony, had a right to appointed counsel because he could not afford one; it overruled Betts. This is a legal ruling, not evidence of effective counsel everywhere.
